integrity: Uniform proof via graph maturity, equivariant deleted-product cellular Euler identity and rational Specht expansion; finite exact-rank and exhaustive small-group checks reproducible in artifacts.
scientific_limitations: Complete rational H2 representation only for three parts each at least 3 and independent within-part permutations; does not claim integral splitting, absence of torsion, part exchange symmetry, or an independent audit.
title: Complete three-factor symmetry of two-point configuration homology on complete tripartite graphs
